note: TestTunnelEndpointLengthsAccepted accepts an AFI-1 endpoint containing exactly four address octets unchanged. TestRFC9012EndpointInvalidTLVsRemovedOnUnicast rejects a short AFI-1 address, removing only its TLV around a valid sibling or selecting exact TreatAsWithdraw without a survivor. tunnelEndpointValid requires a ten-octet endpoint value.
